baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled hour, predicated as their موعد and comparatively intensified by أدهى and أمر.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded rendezvous turns an announced future into their assigned encounter; calamity and sensory bitterness make the second mention an escalation from date to experienced event.

activation_trace.role: A promise bounded by time or place makes the موعد a fixed rendezvous.
An affliction that arrives disastrously supplies the escalation carried by أدهى.
Literal bitterness makes أمر an ordeal to be experienced rather than only ranked.

changed_reading.before: The Hour is simply a future judgment more severe than worldly defeat.
changed_reading.after: The Hour is their fixed rendezvous, and its second naming opens the date into a calamitous, tasted encounter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: موعدهم stands between the two occurrences of the hour, while أمر also carries temporal occurrence and repetition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split mapping of موعد activates enumeration and fixed recurrence: the doubled hour is not vague futurity but an already counted threshold whose occurrence has been set.

activation_trace.role: Enumeration makes the appointment a counted threshold rather than an indefinite future.
A fixed time that returns in known intervals reinforces temporal determination.
Occurrence in a portion of time lets the repeated hour press as a definite happening.

changed_reading.before: The appointment is a generally promised future.
changed_reading.after: The doubled hour marks an enumerated temporal threshold whose occurrence is already fixed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated الساعة is joined to موعدهم and followed by an adjective whose root can denote passage.
baseline_models.mechanism: A distant hour-branch evokes neglected, directionless going; the fixed appointment arrests that drift and turns passing onward into an imposed bitter passage.

activation_trace.role: Unattended going supplies an exploratory image of the addressees drifting without direction.
The bounded rendezvous functions as the point that arrests the drift.
Passing and traversal convert loose movement into an unavoidable passage through the event.

changed_reading.before: The Hour is only an external deadline awaiting them.
changed_reading.after: The Hour also names the limit at which their ungoverned going is seized and made into an unavoidable passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The free-going echo in the hour is no longer neutral drift: culpable severance, loss of direction, and ignition or fevered motion form a self-intensifying circuit that terminates at the appointment.

activation_trace.role: Unattended going provides the focus-side image that the next ayah darkens.
Severe adversity anchors the resulting circuit back in the comparative أمر.
Cutting and severance give the agents' culpability a functional break from right direction.
A lost thing left to waste turns drift into unrecoverable disorientation.
Ignition makes the disoriented state actively consuming.
Fevered madness adds an inward loss of governance to the outward loss of way.

structural_cues: 54:47 immediately replaces the doubled hour's comparative description with the criminals' paired state of ضلال and سعر.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severance, lost direction, ignition, and fevered madness; I infer that disorientation feeds a burning circuit already continuous with the Hour. A live alternative is that 54:47 merely lists two static punishments.

changed_reading.before: The Hour externally stops an otherwise neutral wandering.
changed_reading.after: Their culpable severance has become a lost, fevered motion whose ignition is already the experiential form of the approaching Hour.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dragging fixes the body face-first toward the fire, while tasting and contact turn the focus ayah's comparative bitterness and calamity into an imposed sensory sequence.

activation_trace.role: Disastrous affliction supplies the focus-side event that the next ayah bodily specifies.
Tasteable bitterness prepares the shift from comparison to direct sensation.
Dragging and extension supply the coercive motion into the encounter.
The face as the body's forward aspect makes exposure immediate and orientation inescapable.
Experiential tasting converts the bitter adjective into undergone knowledge.
Contact that leaves an effect closes the sequence as consequential touch.

structural_cues: 54:48 opens with يوم, temporally unpacking the preceding hour, then moves through passive dragging to the imperative ذوقوا and the contact noun مس.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forced motion, frontal exposure, experiential tasting, and consequential contact; I infer that forced contact is how the abstract comparatives become embodied. The alternative is that the comparatives remain rhetorical while 54:48 starts an independent scene.

changed_reading.before: More calamitous and bitter are general intensifiers.
changed_reading.after: The Hour is more calamitous because it takes bodily control, and more bitter because its truth is learned through forced, face-first contact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The appointment's focus-side counting is nested inside created measure: its limit is not an improvised reprisal but a calibrated boundary within an ordered whole.

activation_trace.role: Counting supplies the focus-side idea of an enumerated موعد.
A bounded time or place supplies the concrete appointment that receives the measure.
Measuring a thing in its formation makes calibration prior to the event.
A quantity reaching its proper limit defines the appointment as an exact boundary.
Deliberate ordering supplies governance behind the appointed limit.

structural_cues: The universal كل شيء follows the bodily judgment scene without changing speaker, expanding from their appointed event to the measure of every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formation by measure, exact limit, and deliberate ordering; I infer that the same order governs موعدهم. A live alternative is that 54:49 states general ontology without specifically explaining the appointment.

changed_reading.before: Their موعد is a date imposed after the course of history.
changed_reading.after: Their موعد is a calibrated limit internal to a measured creation, so its severity is exact rather than impulsive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fixed موعد crosses from promise to actuality without procedural delay: one effective command collapses the interval as quickly as a flash registered by sight.

activation_trace.role: The bounded appointment supplies the event whose execution is now specified.
An obligating directive supplies effective command rather than mere information.
Numerical oneness removes any imagined sequence of intermediate commands.
A momentary flash supplies the event's near-zero execution interval.
Ocular seeing makes the speed comparison perceptually concrete.

structural_cues: 54:50's restriction construction joins أمرنا, واحدة, and كلمح بالبصر into a single compressed execution statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an effective directive, numerical unity, a flash, and sight; I infer that the fixed appointment has no vulnerable interval between command and realization. The alternative is only a comparison of divine action generally.

changed_reading.before: The موعد is fixed but could still be imagined as a prolonged process.
changed_reading.after: The appointed encounter is fixed and executable in one indivisible command, with no interval in which its addressees can recover control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressees are counted with analogous cohorts: temporal recurrence in أمر and the comparison branch of موعد turn their future encounter into another instantiation of an already exhibited pattern.

activation_trace.role: A counterpart counted alongside another lets their موعد be compared with prior cases.
Repeated occurrence supplies the temporal pattern linking cohorts.
Falling into destruction supplies the completed precedent for the threatened outcome.
Likeness and counterpart relation explicitly align the present group with destroyed predecessors.

structural_cues: The second-person suffix in أشياعكم binds destroyed predecessors to the group marked by هم in موعدهم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destruction, counterpart relation, counting-with-another, and recurrence; I infer that analogy makes their appointment an instance of a repeatable rule. The alternative is that prior peoples serve only as moral reminder.

changed_reading.before: Their appointment is an isolated future assigned only to the present group.
changed_reading.after: Their appointment is the next counted occurrence in a demonstrated pattern that has already reached comparable groups.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counted موعد becomes the closure point of a complete ledger: enacted deeds are gathered into writing, and scale cannot remove an item from the ordered line.

activation_trace.role: Enumeration supplies the appointment's accounting frame.
The production of an act supplies the accountable units entered into the record.
Writing and book-form make preservation of deeds inspectable rather than merely remembered.
Total enclosure prevents any small or large item from escaping the ledger.
An ordered written line supplies the ledger's durable arrangement.

structural_cues: كل and شيء recur across 54:49 and 54:52, then 54:53 spans صغير and كبير before closing with the passive مستطر.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enacted units, writing, total inclusion, and ordered lines; I infer that the record is complete before the appointment and is opened there as an accounting boundary. The alternative is that the record only attests events after judgment.

changed_reading.before: The موعد is primarily a temporal rendezvous.
changed_reading.after: The موعد is also the closure and disclosure point of an exhaustive ledger in which every enacted detail has already taken its place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing contrast reveals that bitterness is relationally scoped: protection leads to a stable place where promise is fulfilled in nearness to effective sovereignty, while their موعد is the adverse encounter.

activation_trace.role: A promise open to good or harm allows موعد to differentiate outcomes by addressee.
A bounded time or place links their adverse rendezvous to the later stable destination.
Protection from harm supplies the causal distinction between the two groups' encounters.
Stable sitting in a place supplies a settled counterpart to forced passage.
Fulfillment in deed turns the favorable destination into a promise made true.
Near presence gives the favorable appointment a relational center.
Sovereignty supplies authority over both differentiated outcomes.
Effective capacity guarantees realization of the favorable as well as adverse appointment.

structural_cues: The pronoun in موعدهم scopes the bitter appointment to its group, while 54:54-55 replaces being in disorientation and burning with being in gardens and a stable seat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, stable sitting, fulfilled promise, nearness, sovereignty, and effective capacity; I infer that the Hour sorts relationally distinct appointments rather than imposing one undifferentiated experience. The alternative is that the reward scene is adjacent but does not revise the scope of 54:46.

changed_reading.before: The Hour itself is intrinsically and universally only calamitous and bitter.
changed_reading.after: Its calamity and bitterness describe their assigned encounter; the same sovereignly secured horizon can culminate for another group in protected, truthful nearness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a rare nominal branch behind الساعة rather than its ordinary temporal sense. It remains anchored in the doubled focus noun and gains support from the later destruction branch; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary echo, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both occurrences of الساعة at word indices 2 and 4, through the branch that applies the form to the destroyed.

activation_trace.role: The rare reference to destroyed people lets the hour momentarily name an attained state as well as a time.
Falling into destruction gives the rare focus echo a visible contextual endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The Hour is only the time at which destruction meets them.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, the Hour also names the destroyed condition into which that meeting resolves.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain activation from rope-making and therefore cannot gloss أمر directly. It remains anchored in that focus word and becomes mechanically visible when 54:48 supplies dragging; downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for coercive intensification.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أمر at word index 6 through the tightly twisted rope branch.

activation_trace.role: A tightly twisted rope supplies tension and irreversible tightening to the comparative.
Dragging turns the rope-like tension into a contextual mechanism of forced motion.
The body's forward surface fixes where the hauling force is borne.

changed_reading.before: More bitter denotes only greater unpleasantness.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, more bitter also feels more tightly drawn: the encounter takes up slack and hauls the body into its consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from موعد to a swimming branch and is activated only by the later river and seat. The contrast remains anchored through موعد and the closing spatial sequence, but downstream prose should label it a cross-root spatial model rather than lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: موعدهم at word index 3 through the packet's mapped swimming and passage inventory.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or moving as through water gives the appointment an exploratory crossing geometry.
A river cutting the ground with flowing water makes the crossing image contextually visible.
Fixed sitting supplies the stable endpoint and contrast to exposed passage.

changed_reading.before: The موعد is only a calendar point or meeting place.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial model, it is also a crossing boundary: unstable passage for those seized, contrasted with a settled seat beside flow.

strongest_changes: 54:48 converts the focus comparatives into forced bodily motion, tasting, and consequential contact.
54:49-50 places the fixed appointment inside exact measure and instantaneous single-command execution.
54:51-53 makes the appointment recurrent across comparable cohorts and the closure point of an exhaustive record.
54:54-55 scopes bitterness to their encounter by revealing a protected, stable, fulfilled counterpart.
summary.what_was_special: The sequence repeatedly changes the kind of event named by the focus ayah: date becomes bodily process, measured limit, executable command, historical recurrence, ledger closure, and finally one side of differentiated appointments. Distant focus branches preserve secondary images of drift, destruction, tightening, and crossing without replacing the ordinary syntax.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal link from universal measure to this specific موعد is strong contextually but remains reader-supplied.
The counting and swimming split mappings may be productive activations or form-distant noise.
The record may precede the appointment as its accounting basis or merely attest deeds once the appointment arrives.
